description: Coverage analysis by domain and lexical category

executiveSummary.coverageAssessment: Legacy index captures a small fraction of corpus occurrences due to methodology flaws. Proposed methodology will achieve near-complete coverage for included terms.
executiveSummary.recommendation: Do NOT adopt a 50% coverage target until denominators and criteria are agreed. Report coverage separately for defined domains and lexical categories.

legacyIndexAnalysis.methodology: Whitespace-split extraction from candidate evidence excerpts
knownIssues: Surface forms not normalized to lemmas
Occurrences reflect excerpt mentions, not corpus reality

authoritativeSourceAnalysis.note: These two roots alone account for 177 verified occurrences, exceeding the legacy index's 723 total. This demonstrates the magnitude of the coverage gap.

coverageByDomain.note: Coverage percentages below are ESTIMATES based on legacy methodology. Actual coverage under proposed methodology requires extraction run.

proposedCoverageTarget.basis: Proposed methodology reads all occurrences from root-occurrences files

coverageByLexicalCategory.note: Breakdown requires proposed extraction run. Categories below are planned.

verbs.coverageMetric: Indexed verb lemmas / total verb lemmas meeting threshold

nouns.category: Nouns (including masdar, ism fa'il, ism maf'ul)
nouns.coverageMetric: Indexed noun lemmas / total noun lemmas meeting threshold

particles.coverageMetric: Indexed particles / total theologically significant particles

properNouns.category: Proper nouns functioning as conceptual terms
properNouns.coverageMetric: Indexed conceptual proper nouns / total qualifying proper nouns

authoritativeSample.note: Two roots alone exceed 24% of legacy index total

legacyVsAuthoritative.implication: Legacy index severely undercounts corpus occurrences due to methodology

rootsWithoutIndexEntries.maximumPossibleMapping: 649 terms could map to at most 649 roots (likely far fewer due to multiple terms per root)
rootsWithoutIndexEntries.uncoveredRoots: At minimum 927 roots have no representation in legacy index
rootsWithoutIndexEntries.note: Many uncovered roots may not meet inclusion criteria, but the gap is substantial

doNotAdopt50PercentTarget.rationale: Denominators are not yet agreed. Legacy coverage percentages are unreliable due to methodology flaws. Setting arbitrary targets before establishing valid denominators risks optimizing for the wrong metric.
doNotAdopt50PercentTarget.alternative: Report coverage separately by domain and lexical category using proposed methodology

runProposedExtraction.rationale: Accurate coverage metrics require running proposed extraction against data/root-occurrences/ with codified inclusion criteria

scholarlyReviewOfScope.rationale: Inclusion/exclusion criteria determine denominators. Scholarly agreement on scope is prerequisite to meaningful coverage targets.
